text: During the Mexican-American War, Captain John Boyd is [sent to Fort Spencer, a remote outpost in the Sierra Nevada|trigger|travelling somewhere remote], as punishment for cowardice. A stranger named Colqhoun arrives with a tale of a lost wagon train and men who ate each other, and the fort's scout warns of the Wendigo: [whoever eats human flesh takes its strength|origin|old beliefs and legends] and hungers for more. In a mountain cave the rescue party finds bones, and Boyd, [hiding in a pit beside a dead comrade|images|corpses and body parts], [learns the taste for himself|wants|feeding on the living].
